human_scope_review: Owner's physical Android build from merged main 7efe26185e3c showed the app requesting SMS access before a verified login and returned a two-stage phone signup despite explicit 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 owner requirements. Scope narrowly repairs login/registration/consent routing, existing-account detection and first-use tests only. Initial users get one form for name, gender/avatar, Saudi mobile, password and confirmation. On existing phones password sign-in is first, consent after verified session/unlock. After completed new registration Android asks SMS then notifications then biometric. Fail-closed existing profile and OS credential checks prevent data loss. No financial authority, security gate, SMS ledger, legacy migration or cloud code modified. Human QA on signed main APK still required; tests are not real device certification.
user_requested_changes: Show exactly one new-user phone registration form on a genuinely clean installation, not a welcome screen then a separate registration page; collect name, male/female avatar, 05 Saudi phone, password and confirmation together.
For previously registered phone accounts, open the phone/password login fields directly instead of showing a second intermediate recent-account page after logout.
Never allow a stored registered profile, previous finance profile, OS-keystore phone credential, or legacy password verifier to be silently overwritten by a new registration prompt.

Route registration or verified login before requesting SMS permission; new account permission order is SMS then Android notifications and then mandatory biometric and Home; a restored session must unlock existing biometric protection before consent.
Enforce these orders with a focused first-launch and restored-login regression test without weakening M385 or M449 release gates.
